lesson.title: Attack the Backhand the Long Way
lesson.hook: Their backhand is weak, and they know it. Hammer it and they just cover it. Go the long way round: move them off it first.
lesson.memHTML: Move them off it, then go to it.
lesson.tomorrow: Next time you find a weak wing, watch whether they lean to protect it. If they do, go the other way first.

drill.name: The long way
drill.how: Rally crosscourt to your partner's forehand until they're pulled wide, then switch the next ball into the backhand corner. If it comes back short, approach down the line.

lesson.cue: Other side first. Then the backhand.

steps.name: They guard the backhand
steps.sit: Their backhand is the weak side, and they've started leaning toward it before you hit.
steps.q: How do you use that lean?
opts: High and heavy to the backhand
steps.payoff: They're pulled to the forehand corner, and the backhand corner opens up.
steps.principle: If they guard the weak side, move them off it first.
steps.why: They're already leaning toward the backhand, so anything there, hard or high, comes back as a steady rally ball. Wide to the forehand stretches them away from it. Through the middle feeds the forehand they're set for.
steps.take: They guard the backhand? Go wide to the forehand first.

lines.A: Slower, same corner. They're ready for it.
lines.B: Right: pulled off it. The backhand corner is open.
lines.C: Straight into their forehand. You're stretched.
lines.D: They were already there. It comes straight back.

steps.name: Now go to it
steps.sit: Their stretched crosscourt reaches your forehand. They're still out on the forehand side.
steps.payoff: Late and stretched on the weak side, all they can do is block it short.
steps.principle: Once they've left it, attack the weak side.
steps.why: They're out on the forehand side, so the backhand corner is both open and weak. They reach it stretched and only block it back. The forehand corner is where they already are.
steps.take: They've left the backhand? Go there now.

lines.A: Right back to them, on their forehand. They attack it.
lines.B: Their forehand, and it sits up for them. Winner, theirs.
lines.C: Right: stretched on the weak side. They block it short.
lines.D: Their backhand, but they've time to set. Back in the rally.

steps.name: Close it out
steps.sit: Their block lands short on your forehand side. They're getting back from the backhand corner.
steps.payoff: Down the line keeps them on the weak side. Their pass is slow, and you put it away.
steps.principle: Approach to the weak side, and come in behind it.
steps.why: Down the line goes back to the backhand they're still recovering from, and their pass off it is slow enough to volley. Crosscourt hands them their forehand; anything short gives them time to pass.
steps.take: Short ball off the weak side? Approach down the line.

lines.A: To their forehand side, and short. Passed.
lines.D: Right: back to the backhand. Slow pass, put away.
